summary: The main entry point for the clankerlog CLI application that registers and executes all available commands.
responsibilities: Definition and configuration of the command-line interface using Commander.
Registration of subcommands for login, initialization, integration, and diagnostics.
Global error formatting and CLI lifecycle management.
Verification of current file as the node CLI entry point.

symbols.name: buildProgram
symbols.summary: Configures and returns the Commander program instance.

symbols.name: main
symbols.summary: Parses process arguments and executes the registered command.

symbols.name: isCliEntrypoint
